
GENERATE-SUMMARY-REPORT
Generate a comprehensive project summary report

WHEN TO USE
  Use to create status reports for stakeholders showing progress, metrics, and health indicators.

USAGE
  fspec generate-summary-report [options]

OPTIONS
  --output <file>
    Output file path (markdown format)
  --format <format>
    Output format: markdown, json, or html

EXAMPLES
  1. Generate report
  $ fspec generate-summary-report --output report.md
  ✓ Generated summary report: report.md
  42 work units, 87% complete

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec query-metrics
  fspec board
  fspec query-work-units
